versions.changelog:
Optimize for domestic flights: economy-only default, fewer tool calls

Domestic US flights now skip the business class comparison (3-5x price,
rarely useful) and use 2 tool calls instead of 4+. International flights
still get the full economy + business delta with parallel snapshots.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

Fix ClawHub publish to use explicit slug with auto version bump

clawhub sync was using directory name as slug, conflicting with
an existing skill. Switch to clawhub publish with --slug flag and
auto-increment patch version from registry.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>
